name: lookup_default_value
description: Deterministic lookup of the versioned default emission factor for this declaration line's sector/route/country, valid on today's declaration date. Takes no arguments - the sector, production route, and exporting country are already fixed on this line (see the 'Known context' in your first message) and are supplied automatically; you do not need to (and should not try to) pass them yourself. Never invents a number - calls calc_engine.lookup_emission_factor() against the cbam.emission.factor table. Raises if no factor is on file yet for this combination.
